user_message:
Main Flow (gan BR-01..BR-14 ONLY; XOR severity; AND dual investigate; XOR recall class). KHONG cite BR-15+.
Step|Actor|Action|BR|Gateway
S1|ACT-QA|Intake deviation bind lot and plant|BR-01|
S2|ACT-QA|Set severity Critical Major or Minor|BR-02|XOR
S3a|ACT-WH|Place inventory hold Critical or Major; lot status Held/Quarantine segregated from sellable stock|BR-06,BR-14|
S3b|ACT-QA|Skip hold when Minor||
S4|ACT-LAB|Lab investigation track|BR-04|AND
S5|ACT-PROD|Production investigation track|BR-04|AND
S6|ACT-QA|Join tracks; check evidence complete; neu thieu lab/timeline thi dung CAPA close va hien thi loi theo BR-11|BR-05,BR-11|
S7|ACT-QA|Escalate to Critical if adulteration risk|BR-13|
S8|ACT-REG|Review Critical before market action|BR-08|
S9|ACT-REG|Propose recall class None Class Two Class One|BR-09|XOR
S10a|ACT-QA|Close with Class None after CAPA effectiveness|BR-09|
S10b|ACT-QA|Concur Class Two|BR-09|
S10c|ACT-PM|Confirm Class One|BR-03,BR-09|
S11|ACT-LOG|Execute recall shipments Class Two or Class One|BR-10|
S12|ACT-QA|Hold release requires ACT-QA signature after CAPA close; ACT-WH alone cannot release|BR-07|
S13|ACT-PM|Acknowledge Critical before CAPA close|BR-03|
S14|ACT-PO|Approve BA package|BR-12|
Exception Flows:
E-01|ACT-QA|Intake missing lot or plant identity — dung tao case va hien thi loi required field|BR-01|
Bat buoc: XOR severity, AND lab+prod, XOR recall class, E-01 exception. BPMN collaboration swimlanes theo actor. Moi BR-01..BR-14 xuat hien it nhat mot lan; khong BR-15+.

Kiem tra WF: lane ACT-QA ACT-LAB ACT-PROD ACT-WH ACT-REG ACT-PM ACT-LOG ACT-PO; S12 co hold release + ACT-QA signature; AND join sau lab/prod; E-01 co mat; chi BR-01..BR-14. Xac nhan WF du roi chuyen Use Cases.
